title: schellingChords: a sonified Schelling segregation model over chord voicings
description: A Mesa agent-based model that runs a one-dimensional Schelling segregation process in which the agents are chords occupying the beats of a 4/4 window, and sonifies the segregation as it unfolds. A chord is satisfied when the mean Jaccard distance of its pitch-class set to its occupied neighbours falls within tolerance; unsatisfied chords relocate to a random vacant slot.
